notes: Read AUDIT-028 before applying this map. These are source API moves; method owners, optional component checks and changed signatures require deliberate call-site changes.
authentication.Service splits into Components.Authentication, Invitations, HTTP and Delivery. Most former root vocabulary lives in public logic/inbound packages.

authorization.Service splits into Components.Decisions, Relationships, Roles, Mutations and HTTP. RelationshipWriter and SystemMutator stay separate trusted capabilities; do not pass the complete bundle where a narrow service suffices.
Relationships.GetSchema and SchemaDigest return a value directly, without an error. RoleModel shared vocabulary lives in logic/model.

jobs.Service splits into Components.Queue and optional Components.Schedules. Register and ErrSchedulesNotConfigured are removed. Worker fields/handlers move from jobs.Config to queue.RuntimeConfig; queue defaults live in queue.Config.
queue.NewRuntime(queueService, optionalScheduler, RuntimeConfig) snapshots handlers at runtime construction. NewFencedRuntime accepts queue.Service.
events.Service becomes Components. HTTP() returns the public adapter; Register and Close remain conveniences. Outbox poller functions/types move to logic/outbox.
CMS is excluded. No modules or SQL migrations change. Removed imports have no compatibility shim.
